hooks.command: uv run --no-project --no-python-downloads --offline --quiet --python ">=3.12" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start.py" --format text || echo "legion: uv or Python 3.12 is missing, so mode detection did not run; run the legion installer. If LEGION_ROLE=member is set, load the legion-member skill."
hooks.commandWindows: uv run --no-project --no-python-downloads --offline --quiet --python ">=3.12" "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\session_start.py" --format text; if (-not $?) { 'legion: uv or Python 3.12 is missing, so mode detection did not run; run the legion installer. If LEGION_ROLE=member is set, load the legion-member skill.' }
